conditions.today: April 13th, 2026—The radical, rollercoaster ski season of 2025/26 has come to an end here in Jackson Hole. We'd like to give a huge thanks to everyone who joined us during our 60th year of Teton adventuring in the snow and sun. We look forward to seeing you again soon. And if you didn't get to visit this time, start planning now because season 61 is gonna be even more fun. The Aerial Tram will reopen for summer sightseeing on May 16th, with the gondolas joining in on June 6th. Finally, more family-friendly fun and adrenalized alpine action return on June 13th with the opening of our bike park, ropes course, via ferrata, and so much more. Have a fantastic 'tweener season and get stoked for a sensational summer! -Lege
conditions.yesterday: Our 60th season celebrating skiing in the Tetons crosses the finish line today. Spring ski conditions will flourish as 1" of new snow touched up some of the high-country blemishes. Look for AM sunshine to move into early afternoon precipitation as temperatures range from the high 20's at the summit to the mid-50's at our base. Moderate winds will be trending out of the SSW at 10-20 MPH with late afternoon thunderstorms possible. Another chapter has been written, but the final word has not been said, so come out and finish your story for the 2025-2026 ski season in good fashion as this year has been one for the memory banks. Ski safe, finish strong, and we will see you all next November to see what the 61st chapter brings! Cheers!! -MB
